title: BRD.build
description: An optimized build for builders “biruda.sq,” from the head of CoffeeCat :3
body:
**`Note from the Author:`**\
_This mod pack was originally intended for personal use by our “BRD” team, but the members suggested making it publicly available._

![0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ae6ea464f03a9485175c6c83927f7e5f186707a.png)

## Brief Description
_Hello, curious Internet user.\
This mod pack is primarily designed to maximize optimization and boost FPS.\
The optimization is based on the mods [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby), [Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders), [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps), [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), and [Phosphor](https://modrinth.com/mod/phosphor).\
It also includes several mods that improve Minecraft’s performance and fix certain bugs.\
I’ve also tried to include mods that enhance the visual aspects of the base version of Minecraft without compromising performance.\
Additionally, I’ve added several mods that improve existing mechanics and introduce new ones for the user’s convenience._

### _**To suggest a new mod or report a bug, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/VWTGtx27aQ).**_
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88ed19f86e97840f8f44aa01c8e0f3a5d1bd4971_0.webp)
